battle.name: 半島戰爭
battle.theater: 葡萄牙與卡斯提爾戰線
battle.brief: 1807年10月，拿破崙為封鎖英國而入侵葡萄牙，半島戰爭自此開打；法軍陸續投入十數個軍團入伊比利亞，與西班牙王國、葡萄牙軍及英軍對抗，直至1814年4月土魯斯一役。卡面輪發手槍在1810年前後仍殘留於西班牙近衛與砲兵手中，但真正決定交火距離的，是雙方線列步兵手中的燧發滑膛槍。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 半島戰爭自1807年10月法軍越過比利牛斯山進攻葡萄牙起，到1814年4月土魯斯一役告一段落，交戰主體是法蘭西帝國對西班牙王國、葡萄牙王國與大英帝國的聯軍。遠征西班牙由拿破崙本人直接策劃，1808年6月他把兄長約瑟夫·波拿巴扶上西班牙王位，法軍隨即以儒爾當、莫蒂耶、蒙塞、勒菲弗爾等數個軍團分批渡過比斯開灣，初期入伊比利亞的法軍約十萬人，佔領馬德里後以約瑟夫的名義在貝尼特、卡爾特、阿拉瓦、萊萬特四條戰線同時作戰。西班牙方面以卡斯提爾、阿拉貢、加利西亞、安達盧西亞與加泰隆尼亞的國民軍為骨架，兼有大批裝備極差的義勇民軍，由卡斯塔尼奧斯、卡埃斯塔、帕拉福克斯、奧唐奈與拉羅瑪納分領；1809年之後由英軍元帥威靈頓接掌整條戰線，麾下為英國皇家陸軍、葡萄牙陸軍與西班牙聯軍，後方有西班牙游擊隊與葡萄牙義警游擊隊不斷襲擊法軍交通線。英國以少量正規軍配合海軍封鎖，把西班牙變成抵禦法國的大陸堡壘；葡軍在貝雷斯福德指揮下逐步重建，1810年已能獨立作戰，1812年後更與英軍合編作戰。
countriesEn: The Peninsular War ran from the French invasion of Portugal in October 1807, when French columns crossed the Pyrenees, to the battle of Toulouse in April 1814, and its principal antagonists were the French Empire on one side and a coalition of the Kingdom of Spain, the Kingdom of Portugal and the British Empire on the other. Napoleon himself directed the expedition into Spain. In June 1808 he placed his brother Joseph Bonaparte on the Spanish throne, and the French then crossed the Bay of Biscay in successive corps under Jourdan, Mortier, Moncey and Lefebvre; roughly one hundred thousand French troops were in Iberia at the outset. With Joseph holding Madrid, the French fought simultaneously on the Biscay, Castile, Navarre and Levant fronts. On the Spanish side the skeleton of the army was formed by the national forces of Castile, Aragon, Galicia, Andalusia and Catalonia, supplemented by large numbers of poorly equipped volunteer militia, commanded by Casteaños, Cuesta, Palafox, O'Donnell and La Romana; from 1809 the whole front was taken over by the British commander-in-chief Wellington, with British regulars, Portuguese troops and Spanish allies serving under him, while behind the front Spanish guerrillas and Portuguese partisan units kept cutting French communications. Britain fought with a small body of regulars reinforced by naval blockade, turning Spain into a continental bastion against France; the Portuguese army, rebuilt under Beresford, could fight independently by 1810 and from 1812 fought in combined formations beside the British.
people: 拿破崙一世是半島戰爭的策動者，他既為報復英國對法國海峽的干涉，又為執行大陸封鎖體系而開戰，1808年親率近衛軍進入馬德里、越過索莫ierra山口，1810年再赴北方指揮對布爾戈斯的圍城；其兄約瑟夫·波拿巴以西班牙國王身份坐鎮馬德里，卻幾乎無法控制局面，先後在阿爾布埃爾克、布爾戈與薩拉曼卡的敗仗中失去軍隊與威望。法軍方面，儒諾在1807年首度入葡，1808年與英葡軍交手的是杜邦、維克多、蘇爾特、奈與莫蒂耶；儒爾當被任命為統一調度各軍團的「行動中心」總指揮，馬塞納於1810年率大軍入侵葡萄牙，1813年接替他的克萊爾、達武與絮歇一路退回法國。西班牙與葡萄牙方面，卡斯塔尼奧斯在拜崙打敗杜邦，帕拉福克斯死守薩拉戈薩，阿基西拉在巴倫西亞死守到1812年；游擊隊方面，米格爾·希爾戈、胡安·馬丁·迭埃斯（埃斯佩恩西納多）與弗朗西斯科·埃斯波斯·米納在內陸組織游擊，埃斯佩恩西納多一度指揮約四千人的隊伍。英方最關鍵的是阿瑟·威爾斯利，1808年8月抵葡後逐步接管對葡政策，後封威靈頓公爵；英軍在科朗納折損的約翰·摩爾、在薩拉曼卡陣亡的拉爾夫·阿伯克羅姆比與托馬斯·皮克頓，同樣改變了戰局走向。
peopleEn: Napoleon I was the driving force behind the Peninsular War. He opened it both to punish British interference with French seas and to enforce the continental system; in 1808 he marched into Madrid with the Imperial Guard, forced the pass of Somosierra, and in 1810 went north again to take charge of the siege of Burgos. His brother Joseph Bonaparte sat on the Spanish throne as king, but was never able to control the country, and lost troops and prestige at Albuquerque, at Burgos and at Salamanca. On the French side Junot invaded Portugal in 1807, and in 1808 Dupont, Victor, Soult, Ney and Mortier carried the fighting. Jourdan was appointed to a central action centre to coordinate the corps operating in Spain; Masséna invaded Portugal in 1810 with a large army, and in 1813 Clauzel, Daru and Suchet took over from him and withdrew towards France. Among the Spaniards and Portuguese, Casteaños defeated Dupont at Bailén, Palafox held Saragossa, and Eluchet besieged Alicante until 1812. On the partisan side Miguel Hidalgo, Juan Martín Díez, known as El Empecinado, and Francisco Espoz y Mina organised resistance inland, El Empecinado at one point commanding about four thousand men. The most important British figure was Arthur Wellesley, who reached Portugal in August 1808 and gradually took charge of the whole Portuguese theatre before becoming the Duke of Wellington; the British army also lost Sir John Moore at Corunna and Ralph Abercromby and Thomas Picton at Salamanca, and each of those deaths changed the course of the campaign.
kits: 半島戰爭時步兵已全面換裝燧發式：英軍步兵用口徑五百七十七密厘、球重一又二分之一盎司的褐貝絲燧發滑膛槍，法軍用一七七六年制與阿努第九年制燧發槍，西班牙與葡萄牙則用五百七十五至五百七十七密厘的佩德隆式燧發槍，線列射擊的射程、精度與裝填速度全靠它撐住；手槍方面，標準配備已是燧發手槍與短口徑滑膛的特拉布科。卡面的輪發手槍到1807年在野戰部隊中已屬過時裝備，但西班牙並未一次換齊：近衛軍團、砲兵軍官、部分地方民兵與鄉村義警仍配輪發手槍，葡軍與西班牙游擊隊的小分隊也常以之為可靠的自衛武器。輪發機件的價值在於不需另行點火、以發條帶動、閉鎖可靠，風雨與潮濕中仍能點著，故對缺火藥的散兵游擊隊格外實用；但它造價高、一次只存一發，無法應付線列步槍的齊射，也無法承受騎兵衝鋒時的近距離射擊。砲兵方面，法軍用格列博瓦爾制與拿破崙改革後的十二磅、六磅、四磅野砲連隊與二十四磅榴砲，英葡軍用六磅與三磅輕砲及騎砲，砲車與火藥靠牛車與騾隊輸送，攻城成敗仍取決於突壕、架橋與攻城錘。騎兵有英軍的聯隊重騎兵與蘇格蘭灰色騎兵、法軍胸甲騎兵與獵騎兵，以及直屬拿破崙的鑄幣廠槍騎兵，雙方在巴倫西亞與布爾戈的會戰中屢以密集騎兵衝鋒決定勝負。
kitsEn: By the time of the Peninsular War the infantry had fully converted to flintlock. British foot soldiers carried the Brown Bess flintlock musket of .577 calibre firing a ball of one and a half ounces; the French used the 1776 pattern and the An IX flintlock musket; the Spanish and Portuguese used .575 to .577 calibre pedrón pattern flintlock muskets. The range, the accuracy and the rate of fire of the linear volley depended entirely on these weapons. On the pistol side the standard issue was already the flintlock pistol and the short-bore smoothbore trabuco. The wheellock pistol shown on the card was by 1807 an obsolete piece of field equipment, yet Spain did not replace them all at once: the Guards corps, artillery officers, parts of the local militia and the village volunteer bands still carried wheellock pistols, and small Portuguese and Spanish partisan parties valued them as dependable arms of last resort. The value of the clockwork mechanism lay in the fact that it needed no separate lighting, was driven by a mainspring and locked reliably, so it still fired in wind and rain, which made it especially useful to partisans short of ammunition; against that, it was expensive to make, held a single charge, could not sustain a volley of the line infantry and could not survive the close shooting of a cavalry charge. On the artillery side the French used the Gribeauval system and, after Napoleon's reform, batteries of twelve-, six- and four-pounder guns with twenty-four-pounder howitzers, while the British and Portuguese fielded six- and three-pounder light guns and horse artillery; guns and powder moved on ox carts and mule teams, and sieges were still decided by the sap, the fascine and the battering ram. Cavalry included the British Union heavy cavalry and the Scots Greys, the French cuirassiers and hussars, and Napoleon's own Mint lancers; at Valencia and Burgos the massed cavalry charge repeatedly decided the outcome.
tactics: 法軍在西班牙的戰術核心是分散行軍、臨時集中：儒爾當自1808年底組成的行動中心把各軍團置於同一指揮節點之下，行軍縱隊之間保持一日行程以便互相支援，作戰前再以行軍縱隊接續成戰鬥縱隊，步兵營按師展開，以連縱隊突進、射擊後再接續下一波衝鋒，砲兵配屬各師而非集中使用，騎兵則置於全軍預備隊，尋找戰機一擊。威靈頓的做法更依賴步兵線的韌性與側翼：他把營分為兩線，前線營承受首輪衝擊並讓出空間，後線營在退卻中反擊、封閉缺口，利用排縱隊的斜射與對敵縱隊的拒止側面壓制迂回；他堅持不用兩棲式交換，寧可讓出陣地也不讓敵軍突破，並在托雷斯韋德拉斯線把整條葡萄牙國土變成一道要塞，1813年又在比夫拉與尼夫兩條攻勢中以平行縱隊迫敵分兵。圍城則靠近迫壕溝、疊木覆蓋的攻城壕與不敲鼓的靜默接近，1812年4月的巴達霍斯與同年的羅德里戈城都靠夜襲奪取。游擊戰術另成一套：數百人的小隊伏擊法軍補給線，燒毀橋樑與驛站，剪斷通訊，迫使法軍把大量兵力用於護送與警戒，1812年9月埃斯佩恩西納多部炸毀阿爾坎塔拉橋，使馬蒙的軍隊遲滯數日，正是這種戰法的代表。
tacticsEn: The core of the French method in Spain was to march in separate columns and to concentrate at the last moment. From late 1808 Jourdan's action centre placed all the corps under a single node of command, columns marching no more than a day's march apart so that they could support one another, and before a battle the marching columns were closed up into combat columns: battalions deployed by division, companies advancing in succession and firing before the next wave went forward, artillery distributed among the divisions rather than massed, and the cavalry held back as the army reserve to strike when an opening appeared. Wellington relied instead on the resilience of the infantry line and on the flank. He split his battalions into two lines, the first taking the shock of the first assault and giving ground, the second counter-attacking in the retreat to close the gap, using enfilade fire from the refused flank and from the company columns to punish any attempt to turn the position. He refused the exchange of position, conceding ground rather than letting a French column through, and at the Lines of Torres Vedras he turned the whole of Portugal into a fortress. In 1813 he forced the enemy to divide his strength with parallel columns against the Nivelle and the Nive. Sieges were conducted by approaches, covered by fascines and timber galleries, and by approaching in silence without drums; Badajoz in April 1812 and Ciudad Rodrigo in the same year were both taken by night surprise. Partisan warfare followed a system of its own: bands of a few hundred men ambushed French supply columns, burned bridges and relay stations, cut communications and forced the occupiers to detach large numbers of troops to escort their routes. In September 1812 El Empecinado's men blew up the bridge at Alcántara and held Marmont's army up for days, and that episode stands as the classic example of the method.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下：1807年10月儒諾率約二萬一千人越過比利牛斯山進入葡萄牙；1808年6月首批入伊比利亞的法軍約十萬人；拜崙之戰（1808年7月17至19日）西班牙聯軍約一萬九千人對法軍約二萬三千人；索莫ierra山口（1808年11月21日）波蘭輕騎約二千人對馬德里守軍約四千人；維梅羅（1808年8月21日）英葡軍約二萬四千人對儒諾約二萬三千人；塔拉維拉（1809年7月27至28日）英軍約二萬七千人加西班牙軍約一萬二千人對法軍約三萬三千人；科朗納（1809年1月16日）英軍退卻戰約五千餘人面對數倍法軍；1810年馬塞納入葡兵力約六萬五千人對威靈頓約五萬人，布薩科（9月27日）英葡軍損失約二千人；1811年富恩特斯德奧尼羅（5月3至5日）英葡軍約一萬三千人對法軍約一萬二千人，英軍傷亡約一千五百人；巴達霍斯（1812年4月6日）攻擊兵力約五千人對守軍約三千二百人；羅德里戈城（1812年1月19日）聯軍約七千五百人對守軍約五千人；薩拉曼卡（1812年7月22日）聯軍約七萬人對法軍約四萬六千人；維多利亞（1813年6月21日）聯軍約八萬人對法軍約六萬人，法軍被俘約一萬二千至一萬五千人、遺失火砲約三百門；土魯斯（1814年4月10日）聯軍約八萬人對絮歇與蘇爾特約四萬人。整場戰爭自1807年10月延續到1814年4月，歷時六年半以上，英葡軍傷亡以數萬計，西班牙軍隊陣亡受傷者逾十萬，被俘者亦以十萬計。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. In October 1807 Junot took about twenty-one thousand men across the Pyrenees into Portugal. In June 1808 the first French armies in Iberia numbered about one hundred thousand. At Bailén, on 17 to 19 July 1808, the Spanish coalition fielded about nineteen thousand men against roughly twenty-three thousand French. At the pass of Somosierra on 21 November 1808 some two thousand Polish light horse met about four thousand defenders of Madrid. At Vimeiro on 21 August 1808 the British-Portuguese army of about twenty-four thousand faced Junot's roughly twenty-three thousand. At Talavera, on 27 and 28 July 1809, some twenty-seven thousand British and twelve thousand Spanish troops opposed about thirty-three thousand French. At Corunna on 16 January 1809 a British rearguard of a few thousand men faced several times its number. In 1810 Masséna invaded Portugal with about sixty-five thousand men against Wellington's roughly fifty thousand, and at Bussaco on 27 September the British-Portuguese lost about two thousand. At Fuentes de Oñoro, on 3 to 5 May 1811, thirteen thousand British-Portuguese troops met about twelve thousand French, with British casualties of roughly fifteen hundred. At Badajoz on 6 April 1812 about five thousand attackers faced a garrison of some three thousand two hundred. At Ciudad Rodrigo on 19 January 1812 the coalition force was about seven thousand five hundred against five thousand defenders. At Salamanca on 22 July 1812 the allies numbered about seventy thousand against some forty-six thousand French. At Vitoria on 21 June 1813 about eighty thousand allied troops faced roughly sixty thousand French, the French losing some twelve to fifteen thousand prisoners and about three hundred guns. At Toulouse on 10 April 1814 the allies numbered about eighty thousand against the forty thousand men of Soult and Suchet. The war as a whole ran from October 1807 to April 1814, more than six and a half years, and the British-Portuguese losses ran to several tens of thousands, while Spanish dead and wounded exceeded one hundred thousand and Spanish prisoners taken were counted in tens of thousands as well.
cause: 開戰的根由不在西班牙本土，而在歐洲大陸的戰略與海權。1805年特拉法加之後，拿破崙未能解決英國對海洋的控制，1807年7月提爾西特和約把法國推向歐洲大陸體系，他要求所有歐洲國家封鎖英國貿易，葡萄牙王室因長期依賴英國而拒絕加入，於是法軍以執行封鎖為名越境接管里斯本與波爾圖。與此同時，拿破崙判斷西班牙波旁王室的卡洛斯四世與其子費爾南多七世無力控制局面，先在巴約那迫使國王退位、另立費爾南多，再於1808年6月把約瑟夫·波拿巴立為西班牙國王，直接挑戰天主教王權的正統性，馬德里民眾隨即在5月2日發動武裝抵抗。西班牙商船在英國海軍保護下仍照常出海貿易，加上英國遠征軍隊在法國之外的多個戰場牽制法軍，使法國擔心西班牙與英國結盟會夾擊其右翼。西班牙的財政亦因戰事與貿易中斷而惡化，此前兩次寶藏船隊遭英格蘭海軍劫掠更令王室稅收枯竭，種下政府欠餉、軍隊紀律崩解的惡果，於是整個半島在1808年6月之後被拖入全面戰爭。
causeEn: The causes of the war lay not in Spain itself but in European strategy and sea power. After Trafalgar in 1805 Napoleon had failed to break Britain's command of the ocean, and the Treaty of Tilsit in July 1807 pushed France towards a continental system: he demanded that every European state close its ports to British trade, and the Portuguese crown, long dependent on Britain, refused to join, so the French crossed the border under the pretext of enforcing the blockade and took Lisbon and Oporto. At the same time Napoleon judged the Spanish Bourbon monarchy, with Charles IV and his son Ferdinand VII, too weak to be controlled. He first forced the abdication at Bayonne and installed Ferdinand, and then in June 1808 put Joseph Bonaparte on the Spanish throne, directly challenging the legitimacy of the Catholic monarchy; the people of Madrid rose in armed resistance on 2 May. Spanish merchant shipping under British naval protection continued to trade overseas, and British expeditionary forces tied down French armies on several other fronts, leaving France worried that a Spanish-British alliance would close in on its right flank. Spanish finances deteriorated as war and trade were interrupted, and the earlier loss of two Spanish treasure fleets to the Royal Navy left the crown without revenue, producing arrears of pay and a breakdown of discipline in the army. Thus the whole peninsula was pulled into a general war after June 1808.
impact: 半島戰爭對戰局與後世都留下深痕。軍事上，它把法軍大量兵力長期釘在南方，使1812年俄羅斯戰役的補充更加捉襟見肘；拜崙之戰、1811年阿爾布埃爾克戰役等役讓法軍主力的步兵團被西班牙、葡萄牙與英軍聯手打滅，法國無敵的神話在歐洲大陸正面崩塌，拿破崙的近衛軍自1808年阿爾莫蘇夫戰役後再未取得全勝。戰術上，這是近代游擊戰的第一個大規模實驗：數百人小分隊切斷交通、消耗敵軍，迫使佔領軍分出大量兵力護衛，成為後世游擊理論以及二十世紀各國反叛戰爭教科書反覆引用的範例；同時威靈頓在薩拉曼卡展現的斜式進攻、拒止側面與步兵縱隊運用，加上第九十五團步槍營演化成輕步兵獨當一面的做法，都被視為近代合成兵團與輕步兵理論的起點。政治上，戰爭證明法國無法靠一次王朝更替消化西班牙，西班牙王室的信用崩潰間接導致1820年自由革命與拉美獨立的連鎖反應；而英國自此認定西班牙是歐洲大陸的橋頭堡，也決定了英西關係的走向。整場戰役曠日持久、消耗巨大，卻為1814年拿破崙第一次退位鋪平了道路。
impactEn: The Peninsular War left deep marks on the course of the war and on later generations. Militarily it pinned large bodies of French troops in the south, making the supply of the 1812 Russian campaign even more desperate; at Bailén and at Albuquerque in 1811 French line regiments were destroyed by combined Spanish, Portuguese and British forces, the myth of French invincibility collapsed in the open in Europe, and after Almansa in 1808 Napoleon's Imperial Guard never again won a general action. Tactically this was the first large-scale experiment of modern guerrilla war: bands of a few hundred men cut communications and wore down the enemy, forcing the occupiers to detach large numbers of troops to protect their convoys, and it became the standard example quoted in later guerrilla theory and in the textbooks of the twentieth century's counter-insurgency wars. At the same time the oblique attack, the refused flank and the use of infantry columns shown by Wellington at Salamanca, together with the way the 95th Rifles developed into light infantry fighting on their own account, are treated as the starting point of modern combined-arms and light-infantry doctrine. Politically the war proved that France could not swallow Spain with a single change of dynasty; the collapse of Spanish royal credit fed directly into the liberal revolution of 1820 and the chain reaction of the Latin American wars of independence. Britain likewise concluded that Spain was the bridgehead of the European continent, and that decided the shape of Anglo-Spanish relations for a century. The campaign was long and costly, and it paved the way for Napoleon's first abdication in 1814.
result: 到1813年秋季，法軍在比夫拉、尼夫與比里牛斯山北麓連遭失利，絮歇部退回法國，蘇爾特在1814年1月復出接掌西班牙方面軍，但仍只能退守法國南部。1814年4月10日土魯斯一役，聯軍在城東擊潰絮歇與蘇爾特的聯軍，絮歇重傷、指揮權交給阿爾芒，聯軍隨後進軍法國；與此同時拿破崙在巴黎得知巴黎已失守，於4月6日簽署退位條約，4月11日離開巴黎前往厄爾巴島。4月30日楓丹白露條約正式確認流放，西班牙方面則在4月17日由波旁王朝復辟，費爾南多七世回國即位，半島與沿海的法軍分批撤回本土。戰爭由此以法國退出半島、西班牙國土恢復而告一段落，但未善罷甘休的報復隨之而來：法國王軍在1815年百日期間重新進入西班牙，與游擊隊周旋至1817年才最後撤出。半島戰爭留下的真正戰果，不是戰役本身的勝負，而是把拿破崙帝國從歐洲大陸逼退的一場長期消耗。
resultEn: By the autumn of 1813 the French had been beaten at the Nivelle, at the Nive and on the northern slopes of the Pyrenees; Suchet withdrew towards France, and Soult returned in January 1814 to take over the army in Spain, but was able to retreat no further than the south of France. At the battle of Toulouse on 10 April 1814 the coalition broke the allied army of Soult and Suchet east of the city; Suchet was badly wounded and handed over the command to Armand, and the allies then drove into France. Meanwhile in Paris Napoleon learned that the capital was lost, signed his act of abdication on 6 April and left Paris for Elba on 11 April. The Treaty of Fontainebleau of 30 April confirmed the exile, and in Spain the Bourbon restoration took place on 17 April with Ferdinand VII returning to the throne, while the French forces on the peninsula and along the coast withdrew to France by detachments. The war thus ended with France out of the peninsula and Spanish territory recovered, but the reckoning was not settled: the royal army of France returned to Spain during the Hundred Days of 1815 and only made its final departure in 1817 after a long duel with the partisans. The real result of the Peninsular War was not the outcome of any single battle, but a long attrition that pushed Napoleon's empire back off the European continent.
